name: Eiichi Sakaguchi
source:
Well we really didn't MEAN to kidnap him, but this works out for us either way. Stops us from having to get his parents at least!

Having graduated highschool a few years back, he seems to mainly work at points as a personal trainer... But only to fund his crippling addiction to pay-to-win Gacha games.

Despite his strange hobbies, he's an undeniably cheery, and sweet person. It's a shame he he decides to to associate with Shinku Kutsuki, who has been his best friend since childhood. Eiichi, is the self proclaimed #1 fan of Shinku's works and undeniably his biggest supporter after the incident.

It's a shame. His life would have been better if he'd never met Shinku.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Eiichi_Sakaguchi_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
